request: User authorised trying position-aware URL modelling.
data: Reuse unchanged original domain-grouped A2 train/validation eligibility cohorts: 381494 train, 128373 validation. No A2 test outcomes, no demo injection, no relabelling or whitelist.
representation: Shared canonical_model_view at train/inference, followed by separate base-domain, subdomain, path, query, userinfo, fragment and port character TF-IDF blocks. Protocol/prefix text is absent from these blocks; raw original scheme remains used by API explanations. Character terms in different fields have separate coefficients.
numeric_note: Use bounded structural booleans without rare-feature standardisation; omit global URL/path length counts that can dominate short homepage scores. This is a newly trained model, not a modified input to the old model.
root_context: Optional learned interaction: append the base-domain and subdomain blocks masked to root-path rows. No domain-specific branch or fixed safety label; same representation at train/inference.
selection: Among candidates passing all gates, lowest whole-validation FPR, tie by higher dangerous recall. Original and preview remain running unchanged until checks pass; at most update the optional preview, not primary A3.
demo_policy: Do not inspect candidate Google/GitHub outputs until all fits and validation-based selection complete. Naturally occurring original domain membership stays; no demo records are added. Familiarity is not a safety label.
limits: Further reuse of validation for exploratory development, not independent final-test accuracy. Source labels and URL-only coverage remain limitations. Infrequent/empty fields may yield no fitted vocabulary; disclose this. No external URL visits, DNS or analysis services.
